cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Name My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get them to acknowledge exactly what your effort, sacrifice, or strategy added to the result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: In your thank-you speech, mention that I hammered every board twice, just like you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was tapping for rotten wood. You drove good nails through the bottom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, testing their depth. You should say I made the inspection thorough.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You did find the rotten plank near the steps. We replaced it before the dancers arrived.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then name that plank and name me. 'Helped with the stage' won't tell them what I prevented.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies tapping as hammering and A3 covers it as inspection while requesting exact credit; B4 offers a real useful discovery.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 nails through bottom and A3 depth are vague about what was damaged; B4 rotten plank is related but physically underconnected.

relationship.evidence: B4 acknowledges an actual contribution despite B2 criticism, giving A a cooperative route to credit.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 specific plank to demand precise thanks rather than general assistance.

specificity.evidence: A1 boards and B4 stage establish the job, but B2 through the bottom does not name the affected object clearly.
